description:
Make document link checking exit successfully when it finds only warnings, so that it fails only on broken links.

## Background

Link checking has three exit statuses: 0 when every link is valid, 1 when a link is broken, and 2 when only warnings remain (for example a link to an existing file that is not itself a tracked document). Exit 2 stops `set -e` scripts and gates on findings that are advisory by definition, and downstream leads tracked every linked helper script as a document only to make the check pass.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Link checking exits 0 when it finds warnings and no errors, and nonzero when any link is broken.
- [hard] REQ-02: Warnings are still reported, in human-readable output and in the JSON result.
- [hard] REQ-03: The exit-code reference documents the two outcomes.
title: Exit successfully from link checking on warnings alone
